A lowering or conformance claim equates synchronous receipt acceptance with all detached external effects settled, or removes persistent duties after timeout or sibling success.
The staged semantics permits a late callback and recovery to consume the same authority twice, or treats repeated request content as necessarily one invocation.
Exact source evidence contradicts the preserved native/Intents/MPC authority or recovery distinctions without a version-scoped correction.
